title: Legendary Single-Walled Canteen
content: I absolutely LOVE this canteen and not just because it’s excellent lid design but because it has been with me for years to the point where people knew me at work as “Thst Canteen Guy”  It holds alot of water but it’s also one of the VERY few designs that are single walled.  It’s nice to have double walled for keeping things at a constant hot or cold for short term hiking etc…but for serious life and death survival situations you ABSOLUTELY NEED a single walled design to boil water in so it’s safe to drink.  Obviously it’ll be extremely hot so you’ll have to let it cool first but you won’t have to carry additional weight for a pan to boil it in ad you can boil a significant portion of water all at once instead of using something big clunky or too small to fill it a little at a time.  I will also add I still own my old ones but the seals drip some from long time use yet still do the job.  Lastly I will attest to there supreme durability seeing as I’ve had both fall off the roof of my car and get ran over.  As I said before I still use both of them.  One more quick thing.  Shout out to Pathfinder for making what could almost be the best canteens if they took a chance at a better lid design and handles so you could carry one without a case.  This is why I carry my Stanley and no others.  They don’t require a case and the lid design is great.  I even used the smaller portable lid as a tea cup or a water bowl for my dog on long treks.  Bravo for making this amazing canteen!!!!!

title: Added Barriers with each Updated
content: I’ve been using this app for a couple of years and only for the use of tracking all my packages in one place. It’s convenient in that aspect. You’ll get an updated status on your packages in route to you within the app and also a quick link that will direct you to the shipping website to further confirm the status of your package. There are times, when the app won’t reflect the actual location or update of your package en route but you would have that direct link to show you where your package is at. What I’m noticing now with these updates is that ability to directly click on the link to the original shipping website. What used to be a simple task, is now barred with these extra steps/barriers to actually get to that direct link. With the current update, I now have to click on my package, then click on a small link associated with the tracking number and then click on the actual direct link to the shipping website. That’s three pages/clicks I have to perform just to make it to the direct shipping link. Before this update, it was just two clicks. And before that, just one click. Why make this difficult? What started off as a great experience I had with this app is slowly deteriorating with these updates. I’ll see how this goes for now, but I’ll be looking for another app in the meantime if I still have to jump through all these loops just to gain access to the direct link to the shipping website of my package.

title: ShopApp can literally read your emails, BEWARE.
content:
I loved the ShopApp for a long time, it’s like being able to window shop practically all of your favorite online retailers in one place, no opening a million tabs or making new Bookmark folders or new Favorites folders for whenever you happen upon a new site. I get mostly-accurate recommendations on shops I’ll probably like. If there was a “what budget would you like to stay in?” sliding scale type question, I think that would help a lot. Cus it pains me to see beautiful pieces from brands I’ve never heard of, & lo-and-behold, one piece can cost in the hundreds, a top & bottom easily going into the thousands. Would rather I just have never known about it…

But anyways I went into my Google security settings & I wish I could upload screenshots because Google explicitly states that by downloading the ShopApp, you give “them” permission to view your emailS & no I don’t mean your email to send you ads & reminders. I mean they literally can go into the email you provided to them & read anything that you can. They can delete your emails, write emails on your behalf, & Google won’t alert you to any of this because you granted ShopApp access so it doesn’t detect them as a threat or unusual activity.

Since I can’t post screenshots, if you want to see for yourself, go to your security settings in the gmail account you used to sign-up for ShopApp. I am not sure about any other email platform besides gmail, sorry I didn’t mention that sooner.

title: An excellent and natural user experience
content:
This app has positively wonderful UX / UI. Those responsible for it deserve to be commended and they should feel very proud. So, to the folks behind this: thank you. And please continue to design and build intuitive and delightful user experiences. I trust this app and I trust that its information is up-to-date and correct. Again: I trust this app! And you, reader, should too.

title: Poor Consumer Support
content:
I had ordered from this merchant, got charged for the first installment and for several days of waiting the product did not arrive. I tried to contact/ reach out to the merchant (Eyedra) and it seems they can’t be found all of a sudden. My next move was call my bank tied to the purchase and dispute the charge and I got approved (felt supported). Here comes Shop continually messaging me with my remaining balance from a non existing merchant and it’s time for me to reach out to Shop. Initial Customers Support was very poor and inefficient. Until I spoke to a “supervisor” which somehow were not able to help me with my concerns because for some reason, I could “not” validate my identity based on their records “as it shown”. At the same time, I was at my Shop App reading as it stated as to who I am as it appeared on my Shop Profile. I screenshot it as they automatically generated my full name and my last name and had a chance to update it real time while I was still talking to the representative (supervisor). He advised me to send the screenshots to their customer service.
What a way to spend my only night off to be dealing with one annoyance and then come up with another, to prove to them about my identity based of their records. Mind you, I have had several transactions with this app and had no problem coz these merchants delivers expect for this one merchant: Eyedra.
To think that I didn’t feel supported with Shop (Affirm) makes me wanna reconsider closing ties or stop doing any transactions with them in the future if this is how they treat clients. Two word for the day: “Lesson Learned.”

title: Some Legit Stores and Some Scams
content: I ordered a item off of a reputable store/website that i never purchased from before. When i placed my order it later told me i could track the details through shop app. I did. I received the order and everything worked out great. I later wanted to shop for a different item directly on the app itself. I seen different stores listing the item at the same price as one another. That was the first red flag 🚩 . I click on the links to take me directly to their websites and each of the 3 websites had the same items for sale for the same prices. That was the second red flag 🚩Then as i read their return policies and shipping policies, they detail how they aren’t responsible for costs and they give you info to contact them. I then searched the addresses they all gave, and they end up being residential homes in different states. The phone numbers they provide don’t work. That was the third red flag 🚩.  I then started to notice that in the search bar, reputable legit retailers have star reviews next to their names. And ones that don’t have reviews to their names obviously don’t because they are scam sellers. Shop app itself isn’t a scam but their are some sellers on there that are. So find out online about the store first. If they don’t have a physical store somewhere in the USA that you can walk into, then i wouldn’t attempt to purchase from them on the Shop app. Be patient and do research.

title: Great in theory, not in practice
content: This app is great for aggregating and tracking all your incoming shipments in one place. It uses your email to search for shipment notifications and statuses then updates in the app accordingly, though updates definitely lag and I wind up having to check the carriers site for updated information. My real issue is that it relies so heavily on the notifications in your email. Say I place an order from company XYZ. They send me an email notifying me that my package shipped and has the tracking info. That all shows up in the app. Great. But I also get an email from FedEx saying I have an incoming shipment and has the tracking info. That also shows up in the app but as a separate shipment. So now I have two items listed in the app for one shipment with the same tracking number. Not great but ok. Once the package gets delivered, FedEx sends me an email saying my package was delivered. That eventually shows up in the app as delivered. But company XYZ doesn’t send me an email. Unless I manually mark that second entry as delivered or delete entry entirely, that duplicate listing never changes its status from in transit to delivered despite having the same tracking number. So now you’re left with either having to sort through your orders on the app instead of your email then going to the carriers website to find the current status of your shipment because the app takes so long to update, entirely defeating the purpose of the app, or deal with a bunch of duplicates that you have to manually adjust with most shipments.

title: Not worth it
content:
Purchased an item online and the site wanted me to download this app, rather than just email me updates. Firstly it wanted access to ALL my mail so that it could scan it and hoover up all my personal information. In these days of data breaches and fraud, no thanks. Declined to give it access so it took me to the shipping info for just the seller in question and that told me no more than I could see on the sellers website! Overall offers me no value and expects all my personal data in return. App deleted.

UPDATE - I have read the Privacy Statement and of course it states that the operation of the app complies with all relevant laws. However, my issue is not that the app might be doing something illegal, rather it is harvesting personal information way above and beyond its stated purpose which was to track a delivery for me. According to the Apple App Store, Shop gathers, amongst other things, the following: Name, email address, physical address and phone number, even purchases all of which I accept may be necessary for tracking. In addition it can collect (and share with 3rd parties) data linked to you such as financial information, your precise location, user content such as emails and text messages. It further states that such information can be used for the purposes of marketing and delivering adverts.

Because I just wanted to know when my parcel would arrive, and not have data personally linked to me shared with 3rd parties and used for marketing, I removed the app from my device.

I’m very disappointed with Shop but will not use them again.

title: An app that makes the customer do all the work
content: It is quite a genius set up by the creators of this app, as it is the customer who does all the work. Having made your purchase, the item may or may not appear in your app; if not you can add it manually for “tracking”. Once the ordered item appears in your account it will be marked as “preparing shipment”, and it will remain permanently in this status for the rest of time. You will get no notification of dispatch, no tracking whatsoever, until one day the item will randomly appear on your doorstep. We once had a console table arrive with no warning. At this stage it will still say “preparing shipment” until you, the customer, get so sick of seeing it in your list of pending orders you end up clicking on “mark as delivered”, thereby removing the item and any input whatsoever by the Shop App. Genius.

Once the ordered item appears in your account it will be marked as “preparing shipment”, and it will remain permanently in this status for the rest of time. You will get no notification of dispatch, no tracking whatsoever, until one day the item will randomly appear on your doorstep. We once had a console table arrive with no warning. At this stage it will still say “preparing shipment” until you, the customer, get so sick of seeing it in your list of pending orders you end up clicking on “mark as delivered”, thereby removing the item and any input whatsoever by the Shop App. Genius.

title: Great, only a little room for improvement...
content: I’ve come to love this app. I can track lots of packages for free (unlike with the Parcel app), I haven’t seen any ads yet (again, unlike the Parcel app), and the design is very nice to look at. I like the shades of blue. The map aspect of tracking works better here than in other apps. I had issues with another app not plotting points on the map in China. This one does a better job and depending on which carrier you choose (e.g. you could track via USPS or China Post EMS for some packages), it may show you either Chinese or English text. A few suggestions for improvement are: make deliveries editable so you can change the carrier if you make a mistake (right now, I think you’d have to create another listing instead), improve the updates (refreshing the statuses doesn’t always do anything, I’ve had packages arrive but not show that even after refreshing), please add the SpeedPAK carrier (I’ve had several packages sent through this carrier when ordering from eBay), and make a view mode where there are no maps, so that you just see package locations (you’d see more at once that way). Overall, I’m very happy. I’m also grateful for being able to track so many packages without seeing ads (which are a pain and do show on other free apps). Thank you and keep up the great work! 😊

title: It’s okay.
content: While the app is enjoyable and having everything you need under one app makes is easier to track packages, in the last few months there has been issues with package tracking. While this issue is more annoying for the impatience of myself, the issues could use a fix. Package I ordered Thursday December 21st 2023 was NOT a Christmas gift, but was expected to be delivered by Christmas Eve. No big deal it was not delivered on Christmas Eve, the issue was saying it was IN my town waiting for be delivered. Tuesday morning shows up and now it is waiting to be shipped… how can the package be in my towns USPS office one day and then be back in CA the next? I have looked at the actual websites tracking and it not once updated to say it was at my towns local office but says it has been shipped, in fact it was shipped the same day it was ordered. This has happened to 1/4 of the packages we have ordered over the last two months. Now shipping or tracking will show up, then the day of we get a notification we have a packaged delivered, others says a package was delivered in a completely other town, yet won’t tell you the info on WHAT the package was. Whether it’s USPS,UPS,FEDEX,DHLs issue or Shop’s issues, it would and could be a five star app if these issues get fixed. From now on, I won’t expect packages to be delivered when they said they are but I still will continue to use the app.

title: Payment plan
content: I purchased jewelry though Eternate. I received it 10 days later which was amazing. The process was fast, the jewelry was beautiful, and the App let you track each step. I spent a little more money and was impatient to wait for pay day. After reading there was no interest on the plan, I went with the the payment plan though Shop thinking my item would ship faster. This is not the case. You can track each step of the process through the app and it says the shipping label was printed weeks ago and it’s been sitting waiting to be shipped since then. I ended up just paying it off faster hoping that will speed up the process. title: Used to be great, now, not so much
content: The idea of this app was fantastic and we’ve used it for a lot of purchases. Having access to a lot of vendors with tracking information and an optional buy now pay in installments feature was such an alluring experience. In the meantime, Shop and Affirm inundated us with payment emails and now expect us to pay because the vendor didn’t refund the correct loan amount. Once again, getting in touch with Shop (or Affirm) has been a nightmare.

title: Great in theory, poor execution
content:
This app is such a great idea— in theory.  A platform where I can track all of my deliveries from different carriers in one place?  Sign me up!  Well... unfortunately the execution is less than perfect.  I’ve been using the app  for about 9 months now and have identified two main complaints:
1) The tracking updates are ironically never up-to-date.  Every single time I am tracking a package, I always have to visit the actual carrier tracking website to find out where my package is...  Shop usually doesn’t update for several hours!  Very unreliable and frustrating, especially when you’re waiting for an important delivery & it ends up sitting outside because you had no idea it already arrived.  Not cool!
2) Despite linking my email, the app can never seem to figure out how to pull the tracking information from my order confirmation emails.  I always have to input manually.  Less annoying than the tracking issue, but still disappointing.  Other apps I use have mastered this, so I would encourage the Shop developers to fix this.

Overall, 3 stars from me.  I want so badly for this app to work, especially now, since we are all stuck at home ordering deliveries more frequently.  Unfortunately it’s just not there and doesn’t do a good job of what it advertises.  Might as well copy and paste the tracking numbers into Notes and do it myself...

author: tarlizspe

title: “What A Month”
content:
After a month of waiting on this package to make it’s way overseas, it was exciting to watch every stop it made, once it reach the states. It could use more details, such as a direct address so those of us who like to check everything don’t have to google search the streets to see the location for ourselves. Also, twice, the current location bullets were not in the correct location on the map. The first time wasn’t so bad, since the location was only across the street. The second time was when the delivery was complete. The marker was well over a mile away from my address, even though it was delivered correct. I wasn’t home all day, so I made the appropriate calls and was fighting agitation all day at work wondering if my order made it to my place or not. Each misread location wasted my time in efforts to get to the bottom of it, so I hope that your accuracy with markers becomes a priority, if for nothing more than perfect customer service and our peace of mind.

Unfortunately for me, in the end, what I had ordered wasn’t what was sent. So my first experience with your tracker involved fraud, which has nothing to do with you at the end of the day.

So again, the app is great. It just needs a bit of tweaking. Thank you!

title: AI feature broke the app
content: I liked the search feature just as it was. I thought it was easy to use, and let me see all of the options through a quick scroll. The chatting actually slows me down, I know what I want and I just need to find it. If a robot could do it, I would ask Gemini or ChatGPT.  It’s just kind of frustrating, because there was nothing wrong with the search feature to begin with—in fact I often praised it to others and referred them—but now the app is totally broken and useless. Won’t be back by choice until you fix it. It felt like you heard “AI” as a hyped up buzzword, and instead of thinking, do my customers want this feature; and more importantly, does this feature work in ANY way, you thought “Yeah!!! Let’s just do it!!”. I have many years of experience in tech, and it’s embarrassing that the same consideration I tell organizations and agencies to give to what their AI needs are and how to use it ethically and efficiently, was not given in a single quarterly meeting before this rollout was initiated and insisted upon. Once again, to reiterate, you took a 5 star app that had nothing wrong with it, and made the search bar disappear, or at least chose the least intuitive and accessible placement in all of UX, and broke the app, as well as sacrificed brand reputation and customer goodwill, in the least functional rollout I’ve seen in the last 5 years. I’m not against AI in its entirety, but this lacked a human-centered approach.

title: Great App For Free!
content:
I was a dedicated Slice user for years, but switched to Arrive when the former introduced a pay scale. Arrive isn’t quite as visually appealing, but it’s also not an app that you will spend a lot of time looking at. Once you’ve authorized the appropriate email accounts, it does a very good job of scouting messages for tracking numbers and adding them automatically. (If it misses a few, they’re typically linked via a shipping notification email and the tracking number isn’t explicitly listed. Can only expect so much.) I like that I can rename my shipments to a more descriptive/meaningful title. Notifications are timely, which allows me to keep an eye out for deliveries and not worry someone may grab it before I get the chance.

On rare occasion, the app will show a delivery as late and I will have to manually mark it as delivered; I don’t think it’s due to running low power mode as I almost always do this (i.e. I receive notifications in this mode, also). It is uncommon enough to not be personally bothersome. If I were to suggest any change, it would be helpful to directly link to the official carrier tracking page after clicking on the tracking number from shipment detail info. Nonetheless, a really useful app (free or not), and a steal for free.

content:
This app is amazing, instead of having to constantly click on multiple pages to get to see your tracking, this app shows it right away. title: Somewhat Helpful - for merchants w/o tracking updates
content: This is a nice app for merchants that don’t provide their own delivery updates.  However, I’ve found that merchants that DO  provide delivery updates, they are always more accurate than this app.  Notification of delivery from the Arrive app will come anywhere from 10-30 minutes after the actual delivery has taken place.  I love this app for telling me around when my mail has been delivered, especially when I’m not at home.  As far as tracking you can track your packages with the carriers generally just as easily...I don’t know which tracking number goes with which item...so I have to look back and forth at the different merchant sites anyway, when using this app.  Sometimes there’s a corresponding picture of the product, which is great!  But not always.  More information would be useful, such as, the merchant’s name, product name, even if the picture isn’t available.  What I find strange is when I first downloaded the app it WAS quicker than the merchant’s updates...so I don’t know what happened...more users loading the system?  So I guess it depends on what you are using it for.  It works for my purposes and I would recommend it if you don’t need to know immediately when something is delivered.

title: Honest review
content: I know purchasing a couch online can be scary and it definitely was. We read all the online reviews and I read the whole Forbes article before jumping the gun. So, here’s my honest review. The couch itself it’s nice. Looks appealing, the water resistant is nice but I disagree with most of the good things I read from all the reviews. I’d say the best thing as a dog owner is that it is 100% washable that has been a blessing. Dirt from paws I wouldn't technically say just wipes off which was disappointing. The back of the couch! Why is so low?!? You can feel it through the cushion and becomes very uncomfortable even after the very nice customer service sent 2 more packs of stuffing for each cushion. The couch and cushions are fraying already (we’ve had it for less than 2 months) and cover it with blankets when dogs are on it. Lastly, the recommended firm/medium cushions, they get quite uncomfortable. We reached out a second time to customer service before the 10 day return deadline asking if there was anyway we could change our medium firm to the medium soft cushions and we’re told we could not. I strongly wish they could have done that for us because we are not very happy or comfy on our couch. So it’s a nice couch that can grow with you but if it’s not comfortable do you want it to grow with you?

title: App works, but…
content:
The app itself works well, and serves the function that I need it for (package tracking).  If you place an order through one of the retailers in Shop’s network, orders will be automatically added into the app (assuming you used the same email address on the order and on your Shop account).  This integration is really cool, and helps make order tracking a bit smoother.  If your order is not from a retailer in the Shop network, then you can manually add the package once you have the tracking number from the retailer.  Overall, the tracking function itself is solid, and I don’t have any complaints with that.

However, Dark Mode was recently removed with a random update and hasn’t been added back yet.  The Light Mode is blindingly bright, and is much less readable overall compared to the dark theme that used to exist.  No idea why it was removed, but it is causing me to look at other alternative package tracking apps instead, simply because light mode is so bad to look at.  This is the reason why I only gave 3 stars for the rating.  If Dark mode gets re-added, then I would consider this a 5-star app, and an essential one if you order online a lot and need to track multiple packages at any given time.

Please re-add dark mode back into the app.

title: I like what I’m seeing!!
content: You know this app isn’t perfect yet but it’s very close. I must say I’m really enjoying it and I’m a happy customer for sure. Pros: I like that I’m notified when packages are in transit and I like that I can control when I’m notified. I’m assuming the vendor has something to do with that, but it would be cool if all listed shipments had pictures of the items purchased. Lastly, the status updates are not always correct at the time you view the shipment. This isn’t a huge deal for me, but it would be great if this weren’t the case of course. Overall great app with some room for improvement!

title: IT’S A GREAT APP…. When it works
content:
This is a good app to have when you’ve ordered a bunch of things from different sources it’s a nice hub to track all of your orders… when it doesn’t log me out. You also cannot delete any tracking emails because it scans your email inbox for tracking numbers causing your inbox to become stuffed and cluttered with old tracking information. It also doesn’t do a good job at telling you when something is delivered, sometimes I’d get a notification telling me something was delivered days after the product arriving.

The updates they keep pushing on this app definitely doesn’t fix any bugs because some packages are not even being tracked or detected even though I can pull up the tracking information in my email. I’m on an iPhone 13 with the latest iOS update in a major metropolitan city. At this point, this app is only useful because it auto fills your info when you buy from online vendors that support payment via Shopify.

title: Very unstable
content:
I want to like the app but it crashes regularly. After a few minutes of use it begins to slow down, and then either stops responding and needs to be restarted, or crashes on its own. It’s really annoying.

Also, the search cannot be edited once it’s fully performed. In other words, if you begin a search for something and the result doesn’t preload underneath, so you decide to press “return” or you press the magnifying glass with your search query underneath, and you don’t find what you’re looking for, you can’t go back and edit the search you’ve just performed. Going back will remove your query from the search box entirely, and you’ll need to retype the query every time you want to make a modification to your search. This is also highly annoying.

Lastly, you cannot add an item to multiple collections at a time. When you press the heart to like an item, a popup menu allows you to also add the item to one of your collections, but it immediately goes away if you select one of your collections. If you want to  add the item to two collections, you need to press the heart again, and then select the additional collections. It would not be that difficult to change the popup menu up until the user is done selecting collections or presses elsewhere, dismisses the menu away, etc.

author: A. Gardner

title: GREAT but missing something!
content:
This app has almost everything you could ask for in a package-tracking, online-shopping program. The overall experience on the platform is smooth, modern, and very easy, as well as making the process of tracking your packages from all sorts of websites and carriers as simple as your email. I enjoy every moment that I’ve spent using this app and I don’t think there’s any other app like it!

However, I did say that this app “almost” has everything, so what could be missing? Well for one and most importantly: Apple integration. I did mean it when I said I enjoy using this app for what I need it for, but I could imagine how much more efficient and satisfied I would be if there were some widgets I can use to glance at the status of my package on my home or lock screen (iOS 16), or seeing the progress of my package going from “Out For Delivery” to my doorstep with Live Activities, or even just asking Siri where’s my package right now? Not only would this make me want to use the app more often, but it would make life so much easier, thus making me happier.

Thank you for reading and I hope that you could take my recommendation into consideration. Have a great day!

title: Doesn’t sell info & no in app purchases
content: I was shocked when I opened the app and saw it was actually pretty well made considering it doesn’t have in app purchases. No limits on amount of orders you can track and it automatically pulls from your email. No ads either. Read the privacy policy since I was skeptical about how they’re making their money with a completely free app and it states they don’t sell info for marketing purposes. I’m no lawyer but this was also in the policy: “...we may share with third party service providers data and Personal Information we collect from you or from emails that are sent to or from email accounts that you provide to us for the purpose of supporting our efforts to provide you with the App.” What is meant by support is rather vague but at least with the California law your info isn’t sold. You can also request your personal information to be deleted, but they do keep anonymized data from you. So if you’re 100% protective of your data this might not be the app for you. If you just want a nicely designed app that doesn’t barrage you with advertisements and pay for in-app features, this is totally the app id go for.

title: Shop App
content:
Let’s start by saying this is not a review on CGL (Catalyst Game Labs), CGL is great and has done right on multiple occasions. This store is great and I can’t wait to see what they release next.

It feels like I’m dealing with an unnecessary middleman for the middleman. That being said I do enjoy the UI of the app and the various storefronts available as well as the ease of ordering from these shops. I hope this is helpful to anyone. Sorry for the rant.

title: Grateful for this product
content:
I have 5 cats in my care, and it was very difficult to find a healthy food source for them that didn’t break the bank. This product changed everything for me. It has made it cheaper for me to feed them versus the canned food I was buying while also giving them more protein than the canned food provided. I love this product because it has given me control over my cat’s diet with the comfort of knowing they are also getting the essential vitamins and minerals they need.
I also want to share that I am writing this review because I saw too many people give it low stars just because they couldn’t get their cat to eat it. It takes patience to transition a cat to a new diet, and it also may take some trial and error to figure out what they like. For example, my cats aren’t a huge fan of pumpkin and refuse to eat beef, but like when I use spinach and pork/chicken instead. I have also seen my oldest cat who always used to be a little on the scrawny side put on healthy weight from eating this food, so I know I have made the right decision with this product.

Now, I can’t find my packages and tracking numbers.

Are your customers supposed to spend time calculating what’s due and figuring out the correct date to pay it? I already hated how it doesn’t show when the first payment is due on a new purchase. Why? You don’t think that is useful and important information to have handy at a glance so customers can be sure to have what’s needed in their accounts? A first payment snuck up on me and not only could I not manually pay it from a different account, but I also could not transfer funds into the payment method associated with my account. This is the only platform of this type that I’ve used, where you can’t see what payment method you chose to draw payments from, till after the first payment is made. Most people may only use one payment method. But I don’t, because I use certain cards at certain times and sometimes I need to change that at the spur of the moment. This app has zero flexibility where that can be done before making the first payment. Highly inconvenient. So then what happens? They can’t take the money and your payment ends up late, because you can only change the payment method with the link inside of the non-payment/late notice. And when is the cut-off time? If I pay on a certain date, that’s what I expect to be reflected in my account, not pushed till the next day, thereby making the payment late! UGH! This is so dang frustrating!

title: Shop App not very intuitive to use
content:
When I tried to determine how to Archive orders, it took awhile to find it by selecting an item that was delivered & then figure out, by trial & error, how to actually archive it by tapping the three dots on the order, then telling it to archive the order, but then the order displayed doesn’t disappear, making me dismiss it! Concept overall is great!

title: Love it but have a couple suggestions
content:
Hi there! First of all, I think your team is done a wonderful job with this app. It’s proven to be a great place to track my orders :). If I could make a suggestion, I would ask that there be a way/option to “bookmark” certain order so that they stay at the top of the list. This way, I think it would be a lot easier to track higher priority orders without having them get lost in the shuffle, especially for folks with a higher volume of orders (i.e. me).

One other suggestion would be to include a way to tag orders. It might be nice if we could associate maybe a color with a specific vendor that we often use, so that it’s easy to identify them in the list, or if we could distinguish between incoming orders vs returns. I’ll leave it up to you guys to determine how much freedom the user would have to create categories, but it would be nice to see some options here.

Anyway, again, nice work on this app! It obviously wouldn’t be the end of the world without these additions, but they would be nice to have nonetheless :).

title: Used to be helpful, but app updates broke it
content:
I used to recommend this app to my friends, because it was simple.  It tracked my packages and was pretty quick in getting status updates and notifying me of package delivered.  But with each app update, the focus is now shifted to shopping within the Shop app and not about tracking my orders.  I'm guessing this is intentional, as my order tracking is now minimized on the main screen and the "Shops we think you'll love" and all these other shop this item we think you'll love or this retailer takes up most of the screen real estate.  I couldn't care less about shopping within the app.  It annoys me that I have to hit Order updates to see my whole list of things I'm tracking, whereas, I used to see it on the main screen.

Anyways, as a package tracker this app is also failing with each new update.  My packages status in the Shop app are a few days delayed and sometimes they don't even update itself anymore when the package is moving in transit and delivered.  I used to see the same status on the Shop app, as I would on a carrier's tracking site.  Now, it rarely syncs, Shop app shows old information.  I have to manually mark them delivered myself.

title: Best I can say is this app is…odd.
content: I’ve been forced to use this app a few times to track a shipment from a company I like which uses this app to track my shipments. Each time I jump on board and try to trace all of my outstanding shipments to see if the app has improved. The concept is good, but the actual tracking is strange. It tracks the packages accurately in time, but not location. It will show my packages all over the country and even out for delivery in a random location. The item will actually arrive at my doorstep as indicated, but their mapping shows the location across the state or even across the country from where it actually is. I got fooled the first couple of times and contacted the shipper, but then realized it was only the app screwing up location tracking. Weird bug that hasn’t been fixed over the past couple of years so I guess it doesn’t bother anyone but me, lol. Three stars because it actually tells me when my package is arriving and notifies me when it does. Only three because I don’t like the initial moment of panic I get when it tells me someone three hundred miles away is about to get my kid’s Christmas present.

title: Never Miss a Delivery Again
content:
I downloaded this app a few years ago when it went by a different name. I never would remember to check my email notifications for items I had ordered regularly but never really had an issue. That was until an order of mine either wasn’t delivered or was stolen, I will never know. I was devastated as I was really looking forward to receiving that package. It was at that time I decided to look in to delivery notification options and found this app.

It’s easy enough to install and link to your emails. If you have a single email that you use for shopping and junk then this is perfect. It searches you emails for order confirmation emails and tracking emails and updates you on delivery status of each package from the carrier. You can also go directly to the carrier’s website with your tracking information from the app.

If you don’t want the app to scan your email you can use the manual entry feature as well.

My only issue is sometimes the tracking emails and confirmation emails do not sync so I’ll have 2 records for the same order.

But other than that I can track all my packages easily in one place and I have never missed an order.

I was even able to catch a carrier in a lie because I checked the door less than a minute after they said they had delivered the package and it wasn’t there, all because I had this app.

TL;DR - Great app to use if you have multiple deliveries you want to track. Easy to use and everything is all in one place.

author: Garlicgirlgirly

title: Poor information, inaccurate tracking, opaque system
content:
This app interceded in almost every small business transaction I made online. That would have been fine if it was both transparent, and didn’t, somehow, cut off the regular channels of communication from the companies. Latest example, and straw that broke. . . , I bought from a company online. Shop provided a receipt and a USPS tracking number. Fine. Unfortunately, this somehow resulted in no confirmation email from the seller directly to me. When I checked shipping through tracking, Shop shipped that the item was underway but the tracking number said there was no information under that number. I checked multiple times over multiple days with no change. I sent emails through ship to the seller with no response. I finally called the seller with a number I couldn’t get from Shop, and they were quick and helpful. Turns out, there was a UPS tracking number, not USPS, and that the item has just shipped!!! It was never UNDERWAY!

Clearly, many people like this app and, conceptually, it’s nice to have a single place to track things. For me, it simply didn’t work. Not only didn’t it provide extra value, it complicated my purchase process in complicated and opaque ways.

title: Take the When And Where Out of Knowing
content: A year ago I downloaded the Arrive app in my cell phone, to track the delivery of a pair of Raycon Earbuds. I really didn’t know why I decided to download this app. It seemed Raycon was a pretty good company, keeping up with customer demands. And I knew I could track my order through the three big shippers; the Post Office, FedEx, and UPS. Little did I know; in the next year many new companies would arise on the shipping industry sector. The Arrive app brings all the shipping companies together, allowing me to check status of my order from many countries, and shippers around the world. I may make an order for a product go off, and forget I even ordered it for two weeks. This is no worry; because once I remember the item I purchased on line, I can easily open up my Arrive app. Arrive will not only let me know the progress my product in question is making getting to me. Arrive will let me know about everything else I purchased, and forgot about. Arrive tells me the time my eagerly awaited products will show up at my door, right down to the day. So I can let someone know to look for me.  I also know not to do anything else; like run any errands, do any shopping on the day of my purchased item’s arrival. For products I order multiple times; once I use Arrive the very first time, Arrive will automatically work for me on all my repeat orders. Arrive is all ready there, without me having to remember anything.            I imagine Arrive is also a very good tool for merchants shipping they’re products to the public. Because Arrives helps on line merchants better serve they’re customers, letting them know when they’re online purchases will ship, and deliver. Arrive is a great app to use; taking the when and where out of product shipping, and receiving. I highly recommend the Arrive app; for those wanting to better know when online purchased products will arrive, and for merchants wishing to better serve they’re online customers.

title: Great for tracking packages, not so great for buying
content: I originally got this app as a way to keep track of all my the packages. It serves that purpose very well, but the Shop Cash concept and the shopping flow in general is seriously lacking. I just bought an item through the app for the first time today and some charges were not displayed (I think shipping) when I submitted the order, meaning that when I was redirected to the confirmation page, the price was greater than what I had seen on the previous page, with no way to go back. This is a bad experience since shipping costs can be a determining factor in whether you purchase something. There is also a huge disconnect between what shops are/aren’t accepting Shop Cash and this changes very frequently (don’t keep an item in your bag for too long as the deal may disappear in the next hour with no warning). In general there are many places where the price for an item (and how much of a discount you will get) differ in this app. In fact, it’s rare that these prices line up so it’s quite confusing what you will actually be charged for an item.

content: This is a great app, don’t get me wrong I think it works very well, but it’s just not as good as AfterShip in my opinion. As a streetwear and designer reseller, I want to know where everything is at all times and when it will be arriving to me or to a customer, and this app was able to get that done for me.

But after setup all your orders are there, whether you allow access or not.

At best, this app makes order tracking now involve an extra  company, user account, more ads, and another app to take up space. Worst case scenario, is a company figured out how to extract users privacy data to profit from, then made the entire internet have to use their app without the end user experience improving.

title: Annoying
content: The Shop app changes its layout and interface every other week it feels like and it never gets better only worse. The layout is busy and cluttered. It should be a parcel consolidation app FIRST then a shopping app, especially considering they aren’t doing the shopping side well at all. If you pay for a purchase in installments using Shop/ Affirm, the payment schedule never populates and the app gives you the “we’ve run into an issue loading your payment plan” or something like that. When an order is shipped it multiple segments, the main screen shows the entire order as delivered and often times tracking numbers and orders and rendered separately and the app doesn’t give you the option to edit an order. It doesn’t give the option to pair orders to locate tracking numbers and when you try to add the tracking number to an order, it will give you an error that the order already exists. Not to mention, often times the tracking is one to two steps behind with updates. Every app now is striving to do everything but none are doing any of it well. It’s annoying and frustrating.

Thanks.

title: Bring back dark mode
content: I used to love this app. In fact it was probably my favorite app for shopping and tracking orders. Everything I have ordered on this app has came either on time or even early. It’s disappointing and I will continue not using the app until it is brought back.

title: This is GREAT!
content:
The Shop app is fantastic! (And it’s free!)
Now I can keep track of all my online orders in one single app. No more toggling back & forth from order confirmation emails to shipping websites to log in & track packages one by one, and no more stalking the mailman!! :))
From the moment you place an order, it is added to your Shop profile seamlessly as long as you’ve linked your e-mail address. You can manually add and edit items as well.  Once they’ve appeared on your profile, you can then watch your packages journey en route, in real time, until they reach theur destination.
You can get notifications along the way too, so you’re updated at every point delivery process.
Once your package is delivered, you can also be notified so you can bring your parcel in right away.
Don’t want notifications? No problem! Turn them off & just check back on the app whenever you’d like!
Sooo...
If you are someone who shops online & anxiously awaits the postman or delivery driver the moment you click “complete order”, this is the app for you.
Are you a small business owner who often has orders coming in from multiple vendors? This app will help you keep track of your deliveries & give you a better idea of what inventory or supplies you’ll have on hand and when, so you can plan accordingly. It’s a great inventory management tool.

My household & business to-do’s have now become a bit more automated & my life’s been made a bit easier thanks to this app.

I’m so glad I downloaded the Shop app - I’m sure you will be, too!

title: Rare Review for a Rare Product
content:
This app deserves me taking the time to write this review. The amount of time this app has given me to focus on other stuff that matters is almost impossible to calculate.

As an impulse buyer, or a last minute shopper, I want to relax while my package just shows up when I expect it to.

I no longer have to remember, “when did I order that thing?” Or what site did I order it from so I can search my inbox with 1272 unread messages for the one with tracking number. To only then have to search the tracking number, tap the link, and hope I have some vague estimate for where it is in the delivery process.

Not only does the app just automatically add tracking numbers to main screen with a feed of deliveries, it shows you a high level progress map to know where exactly your package is.

It’s accuracy in letting my know when a package is gonna arrive by lets me use my day for what I want - without fearing I’m gonna miss a delivery or wonder if it’ll be home when I get there.

I’m ranting now, but this is the ONE app every one needs whether they order a little bit, constantly buying stuff they don’t need, or they just need to make sure all their Christmas packages are on track with enough of a heads up to let you know if you need to come up with a plan B.

This product as a whole is a case study in truly delivering a product that does one thing really flawlessly and delivers on its value promise every step of the way.

I rarely use this app now… even for tracking my purchases. I hope this helps.

title: Disappointing update
content:
Let me start by saying before the change from Arrive to Shop I would have certainly rated this higher. Unfortunately the change has removed some of the basic, and most important imo, features. Things like being able to swipe to mark delivered or archive a delivery, auto detecting when I have a tracking number copied to enter, etc. are pretty basic for an app of this type and was surprised to find they no longer worked for me. I am hopeful the developers will consider putting these features back but in the mean time I’m actually exploring other apps.

On the plus side I like the interface/UI and the wide variety of shipping providers available to track.  Oh and the new carbon offsetting feature sounds great! Unfortunately removing functionality still means the positives can’t outweigh the negatives for me.
